description: Header file defining asynchronous dispatching functions for executing tasks on blocking executors with retry mechanisms and continuation support.

classes.name: blocking_dispatch_on_awaiter

methods.name: dispatch_on_blocking
methods.description: Core template function implementing dispatch with retry logic for blocking execution.

methods.name: dispatch_and_continue_on_blocking
methods.description: Template function handling dispatch and continuation of tasks across executors with retry.

methods.name: execute_on_blocking
methods.description: Public API returning an awaitable to dispatch a coroutine to a different executor with retries.

methods.name: defer_on_blocking
